transcript: Speaker A: I apologize. Apologize means saying sorry. I feel bad for my mistake. I panic. Panic means sudden fear. I don't feel calm. I rush. Rush means moving very fast. I don't have time. I hurry. Hurry means go fast. I need to be quick. I regret. Regret means feeling bad about the past. I wish it was different. I forget. Forget means I don't remember. It is not in my mind.
